resale_co.contact_title: Fire Official (Office of the Fire Marshal)
resale_co.how_to_apply: No Township resale CO/housing inspection. The only resale inspection is the smoke and CO certificate from the Fire Official (see fire certificate).

evidence.quote: Only one inspection is required for a resale in North Hanover Township:
Certification of Smoke & Carbon Monoxide Detectors
Resale and Rental Requirements, including Application for Certificate of Smoke Detector, Carbon Monoxide and Fire Extinguisher Compliance, and Landlord Certificate of Registration

resale_co.notes: The Township's 'Resale & Rental Requirements' packet, linked from the Fire Marshal page, was replaced with a new text PDF marked Rev 10/26 (created October 5, 2026; the old 'Resale and Rental Requirements.pdf' link now returns 404). It still says only one inspection is required for a resale: the smoke and CO certification. Rentals additionally need a Landlord Registration Form, liability insurance proof and a lead-safe certificate (rental only). Zoning Officer Patti Conrad (609-758-2522 Ext. 215) also handles code enforcement and mobile homes (per the last check); the Township code was not reviewed for a separate resale rule.

requirements: All detectors must be less than 10 years old
Smoke alarms on every level including the basement, and within 10 feet of sleeping room doors
Homes built before 1978: battery alarms must be 10-year sealed units or the inspection fails
Do not replace hardwired smoke alarms with battery alarms; replace bad interconnected alarms with compatible ones
Test all smoke detectors before the inspection date
CO alarm required if the home has any fuel-burning appliance or an attached garage: on each sleeping level, in hallways near bedrooms (electric or battery)
No fire extinguisher required (form says the State and the Township no longer require one)

authorities.name: North Hanover Township Office of the Fire Marshal (Fire Official)
authorities.lead_time: Apply more than 10 business days before the change of occupant for the lowest fee.

fees.label: Request received more than 10 business days before change of occupant
fees.quote: Requests received more than 10 business days prior to change of occupant: $45.00.

fees.label: Request received 4 to 10 business days before change of occupant
fees.quote: Requests received four to 10 business days prior to the change of occupant: $90.00.

fees.label: Request received fewer than 4 business days before change of occupant
fees.quote: Requests received fewer than four business days prior to the change of occupant: $161.00

authorities.how_to_apply: Fill out the 'Application for Certificate of Smoke Detector, Carbon Monoxide and Fire Extinguisher Compliance' (in the Resale & Rental Requirements packet, Rev 10/26) and submit it with the fee to schedule. Check or cash, payable to North Hanover Township. Office of the Fire Marshal, 41 Schoolhouse Road, Wrightstown, NJ 08562. A failed inspection means a reinspection and an additional fee.

evidence.quote: Fill out the application form and submit along with the $45.00 fee to schedule the Smoke & CO certification.
Please make checks payable to North Hanover Township
The State of New Jersey and North Hanover Township no longer require a Fire Extinguisher.
READ ALL DIRECTIONS THOROUGHLY, FAILURE WILL RESULT IN A REINSPECTION AND ADDITIONAL FEE
Questions? Contact the Fire Official at (609) 209-8345 or fireofficial@northhanovertwp.com
Plumsted Township (Ocean Co) is no longer the LEA for North Hanover Township effective 4/1/2022.

fire_cert.notes: Changed from the last check: the fees went up. The new packet (Rev 10/26, created October 5, 2026) lists $45.00 / $90.00 / $161.00 (the state schedule), replacing the $35.00 / $70.00 / $125.00 on the Rev 5/25 packet. North Hanover Township is its own fire code enforcing agency (M in the DCA LEA registry, July 2026; Plumsted Township stopped serving as LEA on 4/1/2022, though the state directory's Smoke Detector Compliance box still shows Plumsted Twp Fire Dist #1). The form title still says 'Fire Extinguisher Compliance', but the instructions say no extinguisher is required. The form header gives 609-758-2522 ext. 218, while the packet summary and the Fire Marshal web page give (609) 209-8345. The www host and direct curl fetches of northhanovertwp.com returned 403; the Fire Marshal page was read through a text reader and the PDF downloaded with a browser user agent.

other_items.label: Rental only: landlord registration, insurance and lead-safe certificate
other_items.detail: Rentals also need a Landlord Registration Form, proof of liability insurance, and a lead-safe certificate (lead inspection fee $200.00 + $20.00 through the Township). Not required for a sale to an owner-occupant.

open_questions: The Township code was not checked for a separate resale rule, but the Township's own resale packet says only the smoke/CO inspection is required.
How long the smoke/CO certificate is valid; not stated in the packet.
